title: Checkpoint - a signed state of the log tree (Section 11.2)
description: Published at least once every 60 seconds. The issued_at of the checkpoint a receipt is included in is that receipt's upper time bound.

tree_size.description: Zero is allowed: a log that has accepted nothing yet publishes a checkpoint of the empty tree.

signatures.description: Log operator and witnesses - an array, not a field: a witness is added, it does not replace the operator.
